name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.fiV_safe'
typeText:
∀ (L R : Nat),
  LE.le.{0} L 9 →
    And (LE.le.{0} 5 R)
        (And (LT.lt.{0} R DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN) (R ∉ DisequalityDispersion.Machine.instVars)) →
      ∀ {V : List.{0} Nat},
        DisequalityDispersion.Machine.SafeVars V →
          DisequalityDispersion.Machine.SafeVars (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.fiV L R V)

source.code:
theorem fiV_safe' (L R : ℕ) (hL : L ≤ 9) (hR : 5 ≤ R ∧ R < IN ∧ R ∉ instVars) {V : List ℕ} (hV : SafeVars V) :
    SafeVars (fiV L R V) := by
  have hLv := safeVars_Lvars L hL
  intro x hx
  simp only [fiV, List.mem_cons] at hx
  rcases hx with h | h | h | h | h | h
  · subst h; exact hR
  · subst h; exact hLv _ (by simp [Lvars])
  · subst h; exact hLv _ (by simp [Lvars])
  · subst h; exact hLv _ (by simp [Lvars])
  · subst h; exact safeVars_FLAG
  · exact hV x h

lines.text: rcases hx with h | h | h | h | h | h
